Nevada has no AI-specific legislation on record as of September 2026, making it one of the states that has not yet entered the regulatory picture at all.

The absence of bills is itself informative. It means there is currently no state-level legal framework in Nevada governing AI development, deployment, or accountability, and no pending measures in this dataset that would create one.

What this data does not cover is whether Nevada has addressed AI through executive orders, agency guidance, or local ordinances, and it says nothing about federal rules that apply regardless of state action. Readers drawing conclusions about Nevada's regulatory environment should treat this as a floor, not a ceiling.
